title: The lane lint reads a full disk as the PR's fault: make it refuse or say so, and remove old lint clones
why: Source: coordinator 04:20 CST Nov 15, relaying runner 10 (relayed; triage reads no other session's box). Runner 10's container ran out of disk (OSError 28): 18 GB of its own old lint clones; it deleted 32 and has 15 GB free. Its #3494 lint at 17c64a217537 failed on about 20 fixture suites for that reason and says nothing about #3494; the #3482 lint failure at 0dfed5f2f9ed (checks-mutate-guard-b exit 1, no report) may be the same fault, not proven. Both lints re-run (lint3494b.log, lint3482b.log). Guard candidate from runner 10 (low): the lint refuses to start, or says so, when free disk is below what a clone needs; and old lint clones are removed after each lint. Existing steps searched at 04:20 CST for disk, clone cleanup, ENOSPC and OSError 28: none covers it. Cost of the check is unmeasured. Clone size and the free-disk threshold are not measured by triage.
note: Harm: a lint that fails on a full disk reads as the PR's fault (a false red) and sends a lane to fix a defect it does not have. Low: seen once, on runner 10's box. Done check: a lint with free disk below the threshold refuses or says so, red on a fixture with a full disk before the fix; clones removed after each lint.
